text: Ten more minutes.
Six o'clock, the phone is screaming in the dark.
One thumb on the glass, and the whole world's parked.
Pillow's like a cloud, and the cloud says stay.
Five more seconds turns into half the day.
There's a little voice inside my head.
And all it ever says is,
Ten more minutes!
Ten more minutes, let the sun wait!
Ten more minutes, ten more minutes!
Ten more minutes, I'm never late!
Seven o'clock, the sunlight's at the door,
Knocking on the curtain like it's keeping score.
Coffee's getting cold in a kitchen far away,
Hold on, hold on, I've got something to say.
Left shoe on, no clue where my keys,
Still I'm whispering, wait, one more, please.
Ten more minutes!
Ten more minutes, let the sun wait!
Ten more minutes, ten more minutes!
Ten more minutes, okay, I'm late!
The sun has never once hit snooze,
So today I'm the one who gets to choose.
Okay. Ten more seconds.
